notes: PARENTAGE CHRONOLOGICALLY IMPOSSIBLE (research 2026-07-03): this record's birth ('1612, Newbury, Essex, Massachusetts') cannot be correct as given — Newbury, MA was not founded/settled until 1635, and her stated parents, Thomas Merrick (I182541960298) and Mary Griggs (I182541960291), cannot be right either: the documented immigrant Thomas Merrick of the Merrick/Mirick/Myrick line was himself born about 1620 in Wales — eight years AFTER this supposed daughter's birth. George Byron Merrick's Genealogy of the Merrick-Mirick-Myrick Family of Massachusetts, 1636-1902 (1902) and WikiTree Merrick-10 give Thomas Merrick's birth as c.1620, immigration 1636, and list his known wives as Sarah Stebbins and Elizabeth Tilley — no wife 'Mary Griggs' and no daughter 'Margaret' appear in that genealogy's index of children. Likely a duplicate/merge artifact: either an unrelated Margaret has been spliced onto the wrong Thomas Merrick, or a Massachusetts-based descendant has been conflated with an English-period ancestor. Recommend treating this birthplace/parentage as unsourced pending a real record.
